steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: You haven't seen the innkeep anywhere?

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Weird. He's not at any other of the places, too. Did he finally figure to retire and kick back at home?

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: If only.

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: What's up, Liu, bud? Something got you down?

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: I-I'm totally fine.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Why do you ask?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: —Your ability's—soil and stone Arts?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Precisely.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: For all your martial talent, you're a shameful fool to not apply it for good.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Tying my hands with your sand, cracking my pole—what freak fighting style is that?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Your pole only lightly splitting against me makes it the strange one here. From whence did it come?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I only use ordinary young bamboo poles.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Then my style of engagement must completely lack rigor.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: What's your name?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Taihe.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Fine name. Incredible.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: It's lucky I could do battle with someone like you at the very end.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: You're a mandarin, aren't you? Tell me, what are you planning, here, with the goblet?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Peace and prosperity in the realm for the ages to come.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Hahah, that's a grand statement!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: But sadly, I still can't give this to you.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: You've got nowhere to run.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: So you say.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: —You dare flee?!
The pole-carrier leaps one step backwards.
In ten years scaling the mountains, this is one step among hundreds of thousands.
Free as a kite that breaks from its string, he rises as the wind does.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Hmm. A hidden technique?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: You won't catch me in the mountains.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Taihe, tell that boy. The Field of Forgotten Water, at the crest of Qujiang Peak.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Don't forget.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Uncle Taihe...!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You couldn't catch him?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: It would be simple if I chased him with full vigor. But...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: He's using the goblet as a threat, forcing Innkeeper Zheng to meet with him.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: In the Field of Forgotten Water at the crest, the two will meet, and one must die.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Is there no leeway?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: I learned its root in our fight just now. There is none whatsoever.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The Field of Forgotten Water, was it?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: We need to seize the opportunity.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: We're lucky we didn't clash with that pole-carrier any. Seeing his moves reminds me of the last I ever saw Huai Tianpei ten whole years ago.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I assume you recognize those two there?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: I told you how my dad's on secret orders from the royal court. Those two are their officials.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Do you know who they are, exactly?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: The giant lunk in the front's a bigshot from the Department of Discipline and Supervision, that's all I know.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I see the picture, then.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I'm not keen on troubling Rhodes Island any... but it looks like we'll need to borrow their power, after all...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: *Sigh* This does put a knot in things, though.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I didn't hear what they were saying, but judging by the direction they hurried away, they're off to the summit.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: And I'm appointed to meet Rhodes Island at that very summit. Who ever knew the venue'd turn out quite like this.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: So do we ambush them at the summit first?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Let's not. They're all fine fighters. We'd be asking for trouble.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Well, what do we do, then—

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: —Wait! Quick, hide in here! Don't poke your head out!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: The innkeeper?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: What's dad doing here...? And...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You look ghastly pale.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Is... Is he carrying his blade there?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: No, it's been so many years... he's never taken it out... he's...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: He's a swordfighter, is he?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: He used to be.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Then it seems he's revived the trend.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: That's not encouraging.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Go.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: The closer to the peak, the narrower the road.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Nearly there now.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Is this the final path?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: The very last one.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Beyond this village, a small ways west, you'll see a long, long stone stairway.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Past its top is the Field of Forgotten Water.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Well, there's a fine coincidence, meeting you all here.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Very much a happenstance.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: What are you two after?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The goblet.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: At the summit?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: There's no point in hiding it now. Yes.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: And someone unaccounted for has it.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Just what in the world is that cup?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: If I told you, would you assist us in taking it back, Ms. Kroos?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: There's a lot more to your goals than just 'taking it back.' You obviously want to use it for something.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: And my guess is your goal happens to be the same as Mr. Lee's. You're all wanting to find its master.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: So why go to all the trouble?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Are you asking us, Ms. Kroos, or... interrogating us?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I'm no interrogator, here.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: This goblet was made by the hands of a great offender.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Offender?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: The offense wide as the heavens.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Court classified. Don't look into it.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: But you want to use this heaven-wide sinner's work to do something that involves Rhodes Island operators.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: How am I meant to help out if you don't tell me?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: My benefactor is quite right.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Though we may be of different standings, there's never any sense in withholding the details when you entrust affairs to people. The proverb puts it well; another's heart is hard to know. Treat each other with candor to get the matter resolved.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Here I was worried you'd gotten lost.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Ahahah. An informed concern, benefactor.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You treat them as your 'operators.'

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: We do.
The youth falls silent.
The youngest of the Sui Regulator's Candleholders, he must weigh the pros and cons, and make his choices.
It wouldn't be any startling revelation.
But he doesn't want any slip-ups made here.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: A fearsome beast dwells in this goblet. It's only a portion of his consciousness, of course.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Lord Zuo.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'm within my rights. If any ensuing liability falls on the Sui Regulator, you needn't have mercy, Uncle Taihe. Apply the legal proceedings.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Dwells?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Contemporary feranmutologists are in consensus that, aside from some form of corporealized body, walking in land beyond land, this ancient colossus also has means to dwell within certain objects.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The ancient literary saying, 'the beast walks with the generous earth,' actually gives some pointer as to these creatures' characteristics.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Er, does any old object work?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Weapons are fairly common. Whether it's ancient Sarkaz swords or modern, mass-produced staves, we have precedent.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But as for the concrete principle, we're still not sure.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Same goes for that goblet, then?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Wherever it goes, Waregeists spring up. We can't say we're certain yet, but we have grounds to suspect it.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The cup is alive, yet it hasn't come to life. The objects around it are all dead, yet live because of it.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: It's been adrift for a long time. It's by a random chance we were able to determine its location.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: So now you're out looking for that offender.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I said, just now, its maker was guilty. But its present master is someone else entirely.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: And just who is it?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: A poet.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: ...My Lord.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Miss Ning.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: The wind is high today. The sun is setting early.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Early, but not so. The time came before I could notice.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: How long has it been since last you climbed a mountain?

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: In antique times, the mountain chains of Shangshu were above human might.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Shu's paths try, as climbing atop the heavens.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: It's different nowadays.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Yet for what difference tolls, some matters shall remain constant.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Nowhere in the Three Mounts and Seventeen Peaks may it be found. Will you still search, my Lord?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I need to.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: You would balk at nothing, deceive me, deceive us all for this need?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I need to find it.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Surely you are aware that e'en justified thousandfold, to impinge is still to impinge, and to contravene is still to contravene?

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Surely you know that should you err once, not only do you forfeit the future, but you bear the brunt of the guilt?

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Surely you understand... I am willing to hear what you say?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I understand that.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: It's all the more reason I cannot tell you.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Because as I serve as a city magistrate, I account for that single city's safety and life. Be it brick or tile or stove or kitchen, so long as the slightest harm comes to it, it is my failure in duty.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: As those that tower above me disagree, all I may do... is try my hardest.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: When first we met in Shangshu, in my early years, I saw that past your occasional obstinacy, you were principled and upright, of vitality whole. I have been staunch in my trust, that should we work as one, 'twould be no trouble we could not surmount.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Yet in this moment...

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: ...I cannot help but be somewhat disappointed.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: These words...

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Are they words of warning, from my friend, Miss Ning, to me...

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Or a supervisory pressuring, from the Imperial Envoy of Vice-Second Rank, the Assistant Minister of Rites, Ning Ciqiu, upon me?
